insights.summary: Per a concall.in results summary (3 Nov 2026), MCX's Q2 FY27 revenue was ₹800 Cr (up 114%), EBITDA ₹664 Cr (78.0% margin, from 67.3%) and PAT ₹455 Cr (up 131%), though a jump in tax to ₹185 Cr slowed profit growth on the quarter. Options ADT rose 225% to ₹12.0 lakh Cr and options clients doubled to 13.03 lakh. The only outlook is non-numerical.
